latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Download Free.

- Instantly converts uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into downloadable 1080p MP4 videos.
- No manual editing required—simply upload photos and describe your request to generate a video for free.
- 100 free credits for new anonymous users; seamless token setup with automatic backend connection.
- Designed for fast, cloud-based rendering—MP4 downloads ready in seconds for social media sharing.
- Includes built-in status, credits, batch processing, and clear error feedback for common actions.
